paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and Average Lagging (AL) for three different decoding strategies on the WMT15 De-En validation set, as part of an ablation study on n-best candidate generation methods. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” spans from approximately 2.0 to 12.5 on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 24 to 31, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines at integer values. Three distinct lines are plotted: “Inconsistency-CE” (blue, dashed line with circle markers) starts at BLEU ≈ 24.0 at AL ≈ 2.0 and rises steadily to BLEU ≈ 30.1 at AL ≈ 11.5; “Consistency-Bi +sampling” (orange, dashed line with triangle markers) begins at BLEU ≈ 27.8 at AL ≈ 4.0 and increases to BLEU ≈ 30.8 at AL ≈ 12.5; and “Consistency-Bi +beam” (green, dashed line with square markers) starts at BLEU ≈ 27.5 at AL ≈ 4.0 and climbs to BLEU ≈ 31.0 at AL ≈ 12.0. All three lines show a positive correlation between AL and BLEU, with the “Consistency-Bi +beam” method achieving the highest BLEU scores across most of the AL range.
